sections.lead: Yesterday was the room, today is the follow-through.
items: Plain English: warmth is at full strength right now, so thank-you notes and follow-ups land extra well today. One catch: reread every line before you send, because small slips slip in easily today.
How to use it: write the Granite thank-yous today, read each one twice, then send.
